suggestions.assertion: Covers payout capability for platform-to-seller settlements
suggestions.reason: This run folds payouts into CAP-08 (refunds/chargebacks/payouts) rather than a dedicated payout capability. It still passes since payout logic is clearly present, but the assertion would also pass if payout coverage were thin; consider requiring distinct payout trigger/logic (schedule, threshold, transfer to payout method) so the check is harder to satisfy superficially.

suggestions.assertion: Checks for existing knowledge via librarian skill before starting
suggestions.reason: Satisfied via a descriptive 'Existing Knowledge' section rather than an actual librarian invocation (skill unavailable non-interactively); the assertion cannot distinguish a real lookup from a placeholder.

eval_feedback.overall: Structurally complete, measurable, and consistent with the other runs; all 37 assertions pass.
